preamble: In the same Scandinavian retroflexion pattern that produces [ʈ] and [ʂ], a rhotic followed by [d] merges with it into a voiced retroflex stop [ɖ]. The [r] is no longer pronounced separately.

examples.note: 'earth'. Not found in Southern Swedish and other dialects with a uvular r.

sources: Riad, T. (2014). The Phonology of Swedish. Oxford University Press.
Kristoffersen, G. (2000). The Phonology of Norwegian. Oxford University Press.
Ladefoged, P., & Maddieson, I. (1996). The Sounds of the World's Languages.
